Analysis code, frozen FAERS extracts, derived result tables and the six published figures for a case-level pharmacovigilance study of the ICANS/CRS phenotype ratio across T-cell-engaging therapies, with a network-proximity layer and a positive control for its degree-matched null.

What is included. The complete pipeline (src/, 96 scripts, Python 3.13, pinned dependencies); the five curated gene modules and the substance-key tables (config/); the frozen case-level FAERS extracts, two GEO expression matrices and the Reactome v98 gene sets (data/); every derived output the manuscript cites, each carrying its own parameters and seed (out/); the figures (figs/); the manuscript source and the thirteen supplementary tables (manuscript/); a full SHA-256 registry of every input and output (data_registry/), and a provenance file giving the endpoint, release, retrieval date and licence of each external object.

What is not included. Four external objects are not redistributed because their terms do not permit re-licensing: the OmniPath interactome, the Human Protein Atlas single-cell table, ChEMBL target assignments and the DepMap dependency matrix.
